messages.author: a8fe9092f8d59d1e
messages.subject: 「請問」如何讓R 顯示 國際音標呢?
parts:
目前因研究需要，有請學長寫了能畫出母音空間圖(圓圈)的程式碼。
但當vowdat.txt裡標明的國際音標卻無法在R 顯示出來! 請問是字體上的問題嗎?如果是,請問要如何修改字體呢?
謝謝回答!!

fn = "vowdat.txt"
vn = c("1", "3", "6", "8", "10", "12")
plot_colors = c("red", "orange", "darkviolet", "blue", "limegreen", "deeppink", "black","pink") 
prob = 0.90  
dots = FALSE 
foundpack = F
tryload = try(library(car),T)
if (is.element("car",tryload)) {
 foundpack = T
}
if (!foundpack) {
 install.packages("car", dependencies = T)
 library(car)
}

vowdat = read.table(fn,T)
attach(vowdat)
numv = length(vn)

if (dots) {
 dataEllipse(F1[Vowel==vn[1]], F2[Vowel==vn[1]], levels=prob, col=plot_colors[1], lty=1,
  xlim=c(min(F1)-800,max(F1)+900),ylim=c(min(F2)-1000,max(F2)+600), xlab = "F1 (Hz)", ylab = "F2 (Hz)")
}
if (!dots) {
 plot(F1[Vowel==vn[1]], F2[Vowel==vn[1]],col="white",
  xlim=c(min(F1)-900,max(F1)+900),ylim=c(min(F2)-1000,max(F2)+600), xlab = "F1 (Hz)", ylab = "F2 (Hz)")
 dataEllipse(F1[Vowel==vn[1]], F2[Vowel==vn[1]], levels=prob, col=plot_colors[1], lty=1, add=T, plot.points=F)
}

for (i in 2:numv) {
 if (dots) {
  dataEllipse(F1[Vowel==vn[i]], F2[Vowel==vn[i]], levels=prob, add=T, col=plot_colors[i], 
   lty=i, pch=i, center.pch=i)
 }
 if (!dots) {
  dataEllipse(F1[Vowel==vn[i]], F2[Vowel==vn[i]], levels=prob, add=T, col=plot_colors[i], plot.points=F,
   lty=i, pch=i, center.pch=i)
 }
}

par(lwd=1)
par(lty=1)
legend("bottomright",lwd=c(rep(2,numv)),lty=(1:numv),pch=(1:numv),legend=vn,bg="white", col=plot_colors)


detach(vowdat)
